faq.title: Your questions, our answers
faq.intro: Can't find the answer to your question? Write to us or book a call.
faq.process.q: How does a project with Clickers Community work?
faq.process.a: It starts with a conversation to understand your idea and your needs. We then send you a proposal: goals, features, timeline and budget. Once approved, the project follows six steps: analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and follow-up.
faq.delays.q: How long does a project take?
faq.delays.a: It depends on its scope: a few weeks for a showcase website, several months for a business application or a platform. The schedule is set from the start and we stick to it.
faq.quote.a: Each quote is tailored to the expected features, technical complexity and timeline. Fill in the quote request form and we will get back to you with a costed proposal.
faq.tech.a: Python, JavaScript, PHP, R and SQL; React, Node.js, Django and Flask; MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Oracle; Docker, GitHub, Power BI and the cloud (Azure, AWS). We pick the tools that best fit your project and budget.
faq.support.q: Do you provide support after delivery?
faq.support.a: Yes. After launch, we provide follow-up to keep performance high, fix issues and make improvements when needed.
faq.remote.q: Do you work remotely or outside Haiti?
faq.remote.a: Yes. We work in Haiti and remotely with organizations in other countries, in French and English.
faq.training.a: Yes. We create digital training content and modules to build the skills of individuals and teams.
faq.confidentiality.q: Will my data and my idea stay confidential?
faq.confidentiality.a: Yes. Information about your project and organization is handled with strict confidentiality. A non-disclosure agreement can be signed before we start.
